messages:
eli: heads-up — seeing confirmed > provisional after resume during a model-variant swap (q8 -> fp). sketch of logs below.
eli: ```
2026-03-05T11:02:10Z router route=canary model=rw-v3-q8 session=sess42 resume=false
2026-03-05T11:02:11Z runtime provisional_tokens=18 prefix_hash=ph1 session=sess42
2026-03-05T11:02:12Z router fallback -> stable model=rw-v3 resume=true session=sess42
2026-03-05T11:02:13Z runtime confirmed_tokens=22 prefix_hash=ph1 session=sess42
2026-03-05T11:02:13Z ledger provisional +18 origin=stream session=sess42
2026-03-05T11:02:14Z ledger confirmed  +22 origin=toolcall session=sess42
```
eli: prefix_hash same but token counts differ. likely tokenizer differences between model variants.
maya: yup. tokenization mismatch is plausible for quantized variants if tokenizer configs diverged. that explains spikes in per-route diffs.
derek: short-term we can reconcile in ledger: if prefix_hash matches and a prior checksum exists within TTL, mark confirmed as "tokenization_rewrite" and reconcile counts instead of double-billing. ledger to store session+prefix -> checksum for 60s.
sara: console needs to surface those events differently — collapse them by default or show as tokenization-rewrites so customers and ops don't panic. also add resume_tokenizer_mismatch metric.
meli: (typo) eli: agree with derek, small ledger change behind flag is lowest-risk. add metric tokenization_rewrite_detected.
maya: runtime can emit token_checksum with provisional credit and echo it on resume RPC; ledger can prefer original checksum when reconciling. i'll add a tiny runtime patch to log checksum.
derek: we'll gate ledger change behind feature-flag, canary for 2 hours, monitor tokenization_rewrite_detected > 0, then expand. also add an alert if reconciled delta > 10 tokens/min org-level.
sara: i'll open a dashboard ticket to add a collapse toggle and a per-session event band for "tokenization-rewrite". also add an annotation when route changes mid-session so these cases are searchable.
ops-bot: Deploy plan: ledger feature-flag -> canary orgs -> 2h monitor -> staged rollout.
maya: owners: maya (runtime checksum emit), derek (ledger flag + rollout), sara (dashboard), eli (customer impact communications). i'll open PRs and include a tiny harness that swaps q8->fp and asserts metric fired.
derek: one more thought — we should also increment RouterTelemetry.Resume("tokenizer_version_mismatch") when resume switches to a model with a different tokenizer tag. helps triage upstream.
maya: agreed. i'll add that metric in the router.
eli: thanks — will notify support if we see customer-facing spikes.
